description: This cabin has a hole in the roof where a meteorite has come through and killed the inhabitants.  The room is smoking and the bodies are burned.  Inside you can collect the meteorite.

title: Strange Statues Cave
description:
**Puzzle:** Each statue has a certain number of fingers. You need to push the buttons on the statues that have the number of fingers: 2, 3, 5 and 7 (prime numbers). 

One of the statues is missing an arm, which can be found in a pile of rocks in the corner of the cave. This statue will represent 7. If you accidentally press a button on an incorrect statue, you can push the button back out by pressing a button on the back of the statue. The order that you select does not matter. It's hard to see this button, so use Eagle Eye and first person view.

**Reward:** Gold Bar x3 (worth $1500 total!)

title: Strange Statues - Painting
description:
This area has a big rock formation with a hole in the middle of it.  Head into the circular opening in the big rock to inspect a painting.

Before or after discovering this painting, you can visit the [Strange Statues Cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=153) and solve its puzzle to earn three gold bars (which fetch a price of $500 each.)

title: Native Burial Site
description:

If you start a fire in the center of the stone circle, it will start to rain.

title: Face in Cliff
description:
A Mount Rushmore-esque face carved into the mountain. Approach from the north to make it to the top. 

The sculptor has died by suicide and left a note which you can retrieve from his body - "Note from the Sculptor"

title: Barrel Rider
description: A thrill seeker went over Donner Falls in a barrel. It ended exactly how you'd expect.

title: Crashed Airship
description:
The wreckage of a flying machine with a corpse inside.

This may be an Easter Egg referencing the Kinnear family from Red Dead Redemption 1. Charles Kinnear creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission, and another of his machines can be found in this game when exploring [New Austin](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=894).  

The wreck here _could_ be the work of Charles' brother Percival, as the corpse wears remarkably similar glasses to Charles.

title: Manmade Mutant
description:
A gruesome frankenstein experiment, made from various animal parts.


Enter the building by climbing through the window on the second floor, above the southwest porch.

title: Oil Derrick
description:
A letter from the vice president of Cornwall Kerosene & Tar can be found on the body by the Derrick, while [Dinosaur Bone #3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=53) is inside it.

Ginseng Elixir can be found in the abandoned camp.

title: Abandoned Trading Post
description: Lift up one of the floor planks to reveal a hidden stash.

title: Circus Wagons
description: A fortune telling machine can be found inside the blue wagon.

title: Bolger Glade
description: Approach the cannons in the middle of the battlefield to add this POI to your journal.

title: Donkey Lady
description:
Inspect the corpse of a woman with a donkey skull tied to the wheel.

This is a reference to a glitch in the first Red Dead Redemption, where the game would spawn an NPC with the behaviour and face of a donkey. 

The glitch became popular after YouTube channel WhereDaBootz made [a video](https://youtu.be/7q7v4F8r9Og?si=Sxr_CjGACSl5iZ1L) showcasing the glitch.

title: Flying Machine
description:
The wreckage of a flying machine, with "Charles Kinnear" written on the back.

This references a character of the same name from the first Red Dead Redemption, who creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission. The wreck here is likely to be the work of a younger Charles, who clearly did not improve his craft with age.

description:
A 3-sided stone obelisk mounted on a square stone. On the west side, a plaque is located that contains the date 1771 and the latin phrase, "Hora fugit, ne tardes" which translates to "The hour flees, don't be late", a popular motto often used on sun dials.

Pull the plaque off and you'll find a gold earring and another treasure map.

description: **Location:** On the roof.

title: Painting in Cabin
description:
Finished painting can only be seen in the epilogue. 

Note: It was previously believed that you needed 100% completion to inspect this location but this is not the case.

title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #4
description: **Location:** In the alley behind the general store - on the wall

title: Mysterious Aztec Writing #2
description: **Location:** On top of the mortuary

title: Coal Mine Writing
description:
At the bottom of the Annesburg coal mine, in the northwesternmost tunnel, carved into the wooden wall. It is added to the player's journal without comment, and serves as the unofficial start to the [Reed Cottage Treasure](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=665).


**North Bennet Flew**

**North Bennett Flue**

**Red Roof, Green Door**

**Brothers I’ll be poor no more.**



This clue is intended to lead the player to [Reed Cottage](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359), north of Annesburg, wherein the player should check the chimney to find the [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30359).

title: Homestead Stash - Chez Porter
description:
**Requirements**: Chapter 2

Climb up a ladder inside the barn to the above floor to find the stash box next to some hay stacks. The treasure box contains 2 x $50 and a jewelry bag. Be sure to loot everything else in the houses too.

title: Homestead Stash - Aberdeen Pig Farm
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards

When you arrive at the farm, there's a guy sitting on the porch who greets you. Greet him back, talk to him and follow him inside his house. Then rob the place. Also be sure to go back outside and enter the door at the southern side of the house. This lets you in the room with the stash. This door is closed until you have followed the guy inside his house. It’s a little lockbox with 2 x $20 inside, be sure to loot that alongside everything else in the house.

title: Homestead Stash - Lonnie's Shack
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 2

Inside Lonnie's Shack there are 4 guys. Kill 3 of them but keep 1 alive. Aim your gun at the last surviving guy and threaten him. Then he tells you the location of the stash. This will be different depending on who is the last guy alive.

**Important**: Make a manual save beforehand.  If you don't interrogate the last guy, you can't pick up the stash.

title: Homestead Stash - Van Horn Mansion
description: Go here early in the game to find two residents inside. Enter at night time and you'll find two people sleeping on the lower floor. Steal the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

title: Homestead Stash - Catfish Jacksons
description: This homestead is occupied by a father and son, though you'll sometimes only find the son inside. Look for the shotgun in the living room, and threaten the son to learn where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

title: Homestead Stash - Watson's Cabin
description:
In Watson's Cabin you find an old lady. Enter her house and use the ladder in the back to climb down into the cellar. Steal her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave. 

Return to the cabin the next day, and you'll encounter the lady's four sons. Kill them all and a lockbox will now be available on the kitchen table that was previously not there. The lockbox is the secret stash and contains 1 x $73.

**Bonus:** Check the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

title: Homestead Stash - Willard's Rest
description:
**Requirements:** Available after completing the first story mission in Chapter 6

Talk to the resident here and teach her how to hunt. Return 2 days later. When you return, have a shooting contest with her and then you can loot her lockbox. Be sure to loot everything else too.

title: Shop Robbery: Rhodes Gunsmith
description:
Talk to the trapped man through the basement window of the Gunsmith. Once he tells you his story, you can hold up the owner of the store and make him take you to the basement.  

From there you can loot the room, free the man, and find a **Lancaster Repeater**.

title: Shop Robbery: Strawberry General Store
description:
Have a look through the basement window before entering the store. Afterwards, head inside and hold up the owner to make him open the trapdoor to the basement. If you threaten him further, he'll show you a loose brick in the wall.  

Inspect the brick and loot the basement to complete the robbery.

title: Robbery: Saint Denis Gunsmith
description:
There's a security door inside the gunsmith that you should knock on before holding up the owner. Once he opens the door for you, kill the guard on the other side and go to the top floor of the building. You'll find an illegal poker room to loot, as well as a secret safe that the players will show you if you threaten them.  

Bonus points if you can complete the robbery without a single shot fired!

title: Robbery: Valentine Doctor
description: You can knock on the door either at the back of the building or inside the doctor's surgery before holding up the doctor and forcing him to open the back room. Try to escape quickly to avoid a large bounty, but don't forget the money and the **Schofield Revolver**.

title: Coach Robbery: Hector (I, II & III)
description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Hector is a clerk in Strawberry post office who will give you a total of 3 coach robbery missions. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel to find mission details and the coach locations.  

Stolen coaches can be taken to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

title: Coach Robbery: Alden (I, II & III)
description:
**Requirements:** Complete *Friends in Very Low Places* (Chapter 3)  

Alden is a clerk in Rhodes post office who will give you a total of 3 coach robbery missions. Buy the information from him and read the notes in your satchel to find mission details and the coach locations.  

Stolen coaches can be taken to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.

title: Rock Carving #2
description: You'll find this carving facing the river.

title: Rock Carving #1
description: This carving is located at the end of the road on Mount Hagen.

title: Rock Carving #4
description:
To find this carving, walk to the edge of the mountain and follow the small mountain pass leading down.
Another way is to jump down from the top of the mountain seen in the screenshot.

title: Rock Carving #3
description: To find this carving, start by approaching the mountains from the southern side of the river. Once you climb to the top, you'll see a passage leading down between the trees. The carving will be near the top, facing the river.

title: Rock Carving #8
description: Just south of Moonstone Pond, you'll find a rock on the plateau with a pyramid carving on it.

title: Rock Carving #9
description: This carving is facing the road.

title: Rock Carving #10
description: This carving can be found east of the Elysian Pool, by the road.

title: Rock Carving #7
description: You'll find this carving near the very top of a cliff.

title: Rock Carving #6
description: This carving can be found by walking to the edge of the mountain and following a path that leads down to a giant skeleton. Walk around the corner to see the carving facing the valley below the mountain.

title: Rock Carving #5
description: You'll see this carving from the western side of Owanjila Lake.

title: Old Harry Fen Shack
description:
This shack is located in the woods south of Braithwaite Manor. Inside, you'll find a picture of a slave's family and a piece of newspaper offering a reward for catching a runaway slave.

After completing Chapter 3 and capturing [Mark Johnson](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=304), finding this newspaper will let you hunt for a new bounty target - [Robbie Laidlaw](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=554).

title: Lenora View
description: This blue shack is located by the road on the eastern slopes of Mount Shann. You'll see a bouquet of flowers by the front door, next to a letter from a man going to [pick up his new wife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785).

title: Clawson's Rest
description: This shack is located just past the Dakota River and the railroad. Inside, you'll find a pulp novel on a small bedside table. There's also [a letter](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892190) inside the drawer.

title: Dodd's Bluff
description: This cabin is located in a valley just south of Window Rock. Inside, you'll come across a murder scene with a gold nugget.

title: Fairvale Shanty
description: _Note: There is usually a grizzly bear or a small pack of wolves in the area._

title: Ridge View Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Vetter's Echo Cabin
description: ||Opening the front door will trigger a bear attack. You can ambush the bear yourself by entering through the cabin's broken back door.||

title: Shepherd's Rise Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Argil Rise Cabin
description: **Note:** Unlocked during the Epilogue.

title: Taxidermist House
description: Home of the taxidermist. You get invited to visit this cabin after completing all five hunting requests.

title: Adler Ranch
description: **Requirements:** Chapter 2

title: Firwood Rise
description:
Home of Deborah MacGuinness.
You can hear her in the shed.

title: Stilt Shack
description: Inside you can find salted meat, moonshine, and predator bait.

title: The Old Bacchus Place
description: Filled with perfect-quality rats. A [Fertility Statue](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=963) can be found in the chimney.

title: Watson's Cabin
description:
In Watson's Cabin you find an old lady. Enter her house and use the ladder in the back to climb down into the cellar. Steal her [Semi-Automatic Shotgun](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=439453) and leave. 

Return to the cabin the next day, and you'll encounter the lady's four sons. Kill them all and a lockbox will now be available on the kitchen table that was previously not there. The lockbox is the secret stash and contains 1 x $73.  

If you come again a day later, there will be a tombstone for the old lady and a newspaper clipping inside the cabin

**Bonus:** Check the nightstand drawer for a Gold Earring.

title: Witches Cauldron
description: Take a sip to refill your cores.

title: Willard's Rest
description: Home to [The Widow of Willard's Rest](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6818)

title: Cairn Lodge
description: Visited during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42).

title: Chez Porter
description: Climb up a ladder inside the barn to the above floor to find the stash box next to some hay stacks. The treasure box contains two money clips and a jewelry bag.

title: Veteran's Homestead
description: Home to [The Veteran](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6816).

title: Van Horn Mansion
description:
Go here early in the game to find two residents inside. Enter at night time and you'll find two people sleeping on the lower floor. Steal the money from their table and loot everything else in the house.

(You will not lose honor for killing nor stealing from these folks)

title: Catfish Jacksons
description: This homestead is occupied by a father and son, though you'll sometimes only find the son inside. Look for the shotgun in the living room, and threaten the son to learn where the [stash](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=810) is.

title: Six Point Cabin
description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=401)

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1
description:
**Note: May not spawn until starting [All That Glitters](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36).**

Approach [Caliban's Seat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=150) from the south and you will be able to ride to the top. Upon reaching the top, before going to the small camp at the very end, head down to the right and follow the path along the narrow cliff-side.

There, you'll find the treasure map in a small gap in the wall along with a pearl necklace - you can sell it or give it to Tilly when she requests one in Chapter 2.

_The next map is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38)._

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 2
description:
**Note: May not spawn until you've found [All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37).**

Search the pile of rocks with the large rock on top.



_The final treasure is found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=39)._

title: All That Glitters - Jack Hall Gang Treasure
description:
Approach the island from the peninsula on the western side to avoid drowning. Use the boat near a shack on the eastern shore, or swim to reach the small island in the middle of the lake and inspect the bushes. The treasure is hidden under a rock.  

**Treasure:** Gold Bar x2

**Note:** May not appear until you've found [Map 1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=37) and [Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=38).

title: Money Lending and Other Sins
description:
~$35 inside the tree with a hole in it

You need [Chick's Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=928381).

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: Inside the hollow tree at Face Rock

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description: On top of the [Serpent Mound](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=906), you'll find **Poisonous Trail Map 3** in the stones that look like a nest of eggs.

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure
description:
**NB: Bring a lantern to see inside the cave, and make sure you've collected the [Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=174), or this treasure won't spawn.**

Walk through the waterfall to find the secret cave. Climb over the first ledge, and drop down the steep drop. Look for another steep path to the right, and head down it.  If you come to a massive chamber with natural light breaking through, you've gone too far.

You'll come to a small triangular tunnel entrance that you have to crouch to go through.  Take the right-hand path after going through.  When this chamber opens up, you'll see a ledge that you need to run and jump off. You'll land below it and slide down into some water, and then you can climb up one last ledge and search for a boulder to find 4 x gold bars ($500).

title: Poisonous Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
description:
Inside the lockbox underneath a bed in the cabin where Flaco Hernandez is encountered during [The Noblest of Men, and a Woman](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=42) - but progressing that questline is not necessary.

The hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=173).

title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2
description:
**Requirements:** High Stakes Treasure Map 1, purchased or looted from a treasure hunter found in a random event. If the opportunity is missed three times, the map will be sold by a fence.

The second map is located behind the waterfall here.  You must climb up a log to enter the waterfall. 

_Tip: Use first person view if you can't see anything after entering the waterfall._

**Next Map:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

title: High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3
description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306)

The third map is located inside a hole in a log that bridges from the island to the shore.  To access the log, you must approach from the south side of the island.

title: High Stakes Treasure
description:
**Requirements:** [High Stakes Treasure Map - Map 3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=307)

When facing the river, take the left path along the cliff edge.  You'll pass a Rock Carving on the way.  Take the path above it.  You'll then need to jump down a gap.  And then fall down once more (you'll take damage this time).  Then crawl under a nearby ledge, and there you'll find 3 x gold bars ($500 each)

title: Otis Miller's Treasure
description:
Hidden inside a small cave.

**Note:** Only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

title: Reed Cottage Treasure - Start
description: Located inside the chimney in Reed Cottage

title: Reed Cottage Treasure
description:
**Requirements:** [Sketched Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=664) from Reed Cottage  
**Reward:** 1 Gold Ingot ($300)

Located under a small rock behind a larger rock in the open.

title: Gold Bar
description:
**Requirements:** Chapter 4 onwards.

**SPOILERS:** The treasure is located a few steps left of the corpse, inside a lockbox that's under a wall to the left of the doorway.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Start
description:
Inside the jail cell on the bed.

**Note:** Only available to those who pre-ordered the digital version of Red Dead Redemption 2 for the PlayStation 4 or Xbox One prior to August 15, 2018.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2
description:
**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19255)

Within the underground passage, in the dirt wall near a wooden crate with a lamp on it. Look out for a white 'X' carved into the upper top beam.

title: Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure
description:
Inside the small chapel - behind one of the plates.  

**Prerequisites:** [Le Tresor Des Morts Treasure - Map 2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19256)  
**Reward:** 6 Gold Bars ($500 each at the Fence).

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Start
description: Shoot the hanging corpse down to loot the _The Elemental Trail Map 1_ from his corpse.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: The Elemental Trail Map 2 is located inside the fireplace in the ruined house.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description: The Elemental Trail Map 3 is located on the wooden pathway above head. Access via the wooden platform on the hill to the east.

title: The Elemental Trail Treasure
description:
By the grave beside the tree and gate.

**Reward:** 
- Crow Beak Trinket (Looted ammo increased by 10%)
- Large Gold Bar

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Start
description: Approach the west side of the obelisk where the engraved plaque is located. The map is hidden behind the plaque.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 2
description: Underneath the bell on the roof of the Tiny Church

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 3
description:
On top of the Mysterious Hill Home - behind the lower boarded up window.

May only appear during the daytime.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4
description: Inside the tree on the hill at the center of the Bolger Glade civil war battlefield.

title: Landmarks of Riches Treasure
description:
Under a rock at the base of the sundial on top of Mount Shann

**Treasure:** 6 x Gold Bar

**Note** - You need to have found the [Landmarks of Riches Treasure Hunt - Map 4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21252) before it will spawn.

title: Nevada Hat
description:
Behind the waterfall around the same height as the railroad. Approach from the east and drop down to a path, then head towards the waterfall to find it on a rock.

Underneath the hat, you'll find the suicide note of Robert Elliot - a character featured on the Stars of the Stage cigarette cards.

**Note:** There are also some fish (Perch, Chain Pickerel, Bluegill, Rock Bass & Sockeye Salmon) that fall from the waterfall nearby and end up on the cliff edge, making this a very useful spot when attempting Master Hunter Challenge 8.

title: Viking Helmet
description: In a cave near the stone altar, where the Viking Hatchet is found.

title: Pig Mask
description: Hanging beside a pig carcass and some sausages in the shack.

title: Cat Skull Mask
description: Found inside an abandoned building at the water's edge

title: Pagan Skull Mask
description: This mask is on a corpse surrounded by ritualistic markings on the ground.

title: Civil War Hardee Hat
description: Found in the basement of Fort Brennand. The basement entrance is in the hut behind some crates, at the back right.

title: Tricorn Hat
description:
This pirate hat is located behind a wooden wall inside the shipwreck.

To get across the water, you can either hijack a boat as it passes, or cross with your horse at the most shallow point

title: True Tales of Frank Heck, No.102
description: Found on a nightstand inside the shack.

title: Meteorite #2
description: In the hole in the floor inside the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152)

title: Torn Treasure Map 2
description:
Found in a drawer inside the hermit's shack. 

This map is one half of a whole. The other half of the map can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=379).

title: Wild West Heroes, No. 132
description: Found on a nightstand in the house at Downes Ranch.

title: Otis Miller and the Arabian Prince
description: Found on a nightstand inside the shack.

title: Torn Treasure Map 1
description:
Found inside a drawer in front of a window in the hermit's shack.

This map is one half of a whole. The other half of the map can be found [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=372).

title: Otis Miller and the Black-Hearted Lady
description: This book is lying on a nightstand inside the Osman Grove shack.

title: Otis Miller and the Boy from New York
description: Found on a table in the abandoned schoolhouse.

title: Abalone Shell Fragment
description:
Found inside an old house just north of the Sheriff's Station.

Used to craft the Bison Horn Talisman.

title: Ram Skull Mask
description:
Found hanging from one of the wooden pillars of the abandoned pergola.

Can be used to conceal your identity while committing crimes.

title: Miner's Hat
description:
On a corpse beside the [Wide-Blade Knife](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=371). Use the plunger by the entrance to blow up the rocks in the way.

This hat is super useful, as it has a built-in light - meaning you don't need to carry your lantern to see in the dark.

title: Morion Helmet
description: Located on the body of the [Frozen Settler](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=896).

title: Cobalt Petrified Wood
description:
Found in a chest on a cart, just under a large overhanging rock. You'll also find some money in the chest.

Used to craft a Boar Tusk Talisman at the Fence.

title: Ancient Viking Comb
description:
On a shelf with 4 skulls on it, beside where the Viking Helmet is. Break open the skulls, and the comb will be underneath.

To ensure you get to keep it, hold off on collecting the comb until the epilogue.

title: Scarecrow Hat
description: On top of the scarecrow in the field (shoot it off the scarecrow to collect it).

title: Female Fertility Statue
description: Found inside a lockbox beneath the chair on the porch of the [Roadside Brothel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30355).

title: Fertility Statue
description: Found hidden in the chimney of [The Old Bacchus Place](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=36718).

title: Gold Shield
description:
This item can be taken from Braithwaite Manor, but **only** during the chapter 3 mission *Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern*. 

It is on a mantelpiece downstairs in the first room on the left.

title: Ancient Necklace
description: **Location:** In a drawer inside the Scratching Post shack.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

title: Faded Letter
description:
**Location:** Under a tree in a lock box.
  
**Description:** Letter to Douglas Gray from Lucille Braithwaite

title: Chinese Skullcap
description: **Location:** Beside the corpse of a Chinese man.  On the body you will also find the "Letter to Zhou Yi from Zhou Wei"

title: Ammolite & Fluorite
description:
2 unique gemstones are found inside a birds nest on a high ledge of the mountains.  The path to get there is tricky - approach from the north, just above the train tracks, and hop across the rock ledges.

These can be sold to the fence for $25 each, and you'll also come across a lockbox holding [Aged Pirate Rum, Bill Fold & Coin Bag](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=822) on the way.

title: Ancient Arrowhead
description:
**Required:** Find all 20 [Dreamcatchers](https://rdr2map.com?search=dreamcatcher)

If you connect all Dreamcatcher points on the map, it forms the image of a buffalo. Within Elysian Cave, the item is inside the cave painting of the buffalo.

title: Hawk Talon Trinket
description:
Behind the waterfall at Deadboot Creek, inside a lockbox.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** 30% stamina drain decrease when drawing a bow

title: Cat Eye Trinket
description:
In a lock box by a crate.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases the length of Fortifying tonic effects by 20%

title: Shark Tooth Trinket
description:
In a lock box by the shipwreck.

**Requirements:** Chapter 2 onwards  
**Ability:** Permanently increases player's horse bonding experience by 10%.

title: Turtle Shell Trinket
description:
In a lock box under the stairs. Can only be picked up after killing all Del Lobo enemies nearby.

**Ability:** Permanently increases player's health bar refill speed by 10%.

title: Scarecrow Derby Hat
description: On the scarecrow

title: Scarecrow Sombrero
description: Worn by a scarecrow amongst the corn. You can shoot it off once Dutch lifts the ban on guns in Rhodes, or knock the scarecrow over by riding into it with your horse.

title: Scarecrow Top Hat
description: On the scarecrow. Shoot it off.

title: Meteorite #1
description: Inside the crater

title: Shrunken Head
description: Inside the small cabin.  Shoot the small clay jar below the painting to get the Shrunken Head.

title: Letter to Uncle Lewis from Elijah
description: Found on the body of a runaway slave

title: Electric Lantern
description: After completing [A Bright Bouncing Boy (II)](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454739), return to his lab after 48 in-game hours have passed.

title: Letter to Garfield from Martha
description: On a dead soldier, pinned to a tree by a bayonet style rifle stuck through him.  He has a "traitor" sign hanging around his neck, and the letter is in his right pocket area.  You may need to use Dead Eye to see the letter.

title: The Lady of the Manor
description:
***Epilogue Only***

Given to you by Mary-Beth when she's encountered at the train station.

title: Letter to Annette from Claude
description:
Inside Robard Farm you will find the the corpses of a man and a woman.

Behind the farm, there is another woman's body lying against the wheel of the wagon, with a Cattleman revolver in her hand.  If you loot her body, you will find this letter revealing the reason they are all dead.

title: Dutch's Speech Notes
description:
On top of a crate located at the very south end of the Horseshoe Overlook camp.

Only found during Chapter 2.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

title: Catherine's Brooch
description:
Can be sold to a fence. You can also find a [Large Gold Bar](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=812) in the house.

**Note:** Only available after the Chapter 3 mission _"Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern"_

title: Old Brass Compass
description:
Rewarded for completing [Geology for Beginners](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=124). 

Required to craft the _Raven Claw Talisman_.

title: Panoramic Map
description: One of many potential spawns for the Panoramic Map, found near a frozen couple as part of a random event.

title: Panama Fedora, Boater Hat, Military Cavalry Hat & Gaucho Hat
description:
All worn by various NPC's at the Rhodes post office.

If stolen, they can be found in your collection when changing clothes.

title: Lost Letter to Bonnie
description: Handed to you by a corpse as part of the Bad Luck, Bonnie random event.

title: Experiment Notes
description: Four experiment notes can be found in the room with the [Manmade Mutant](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=873).

title: English Spelling Practice
description:
Found by the entrance of the burnt church, a letter written by the native students at Fort Riggs.

If you take the first letter of each word, it spells out a secret message:

_Waziya comes with winter breath_    
_His trees stand guard whispering all night that we sleep in our grave_    
_Father fought and died so quickly_     
_Mother dies slow_

title: Letter from Cornwall Kerosene and Tar
description: Found on a corpse at the Oil Derrick

title: Liability Agreement
description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [The Wisdom of the Elders](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=6817) V

On a table in Butcher’s Creek

title: Letter to Martha from Garfield
description: On the table in the cabin at Martha's Swain.

title: Grave Newspaper Clipping
description: On a table inside the shack.

title: Letter from St. Luke's Academy
description: You can loot this letter from one of the corpses during the third [Appleseed Timber](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2414) event, after killing the wolves.

title: Classic Raccoon Mountain Hat
description:
Find a large man named [Jon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=944) in the Valentine saloon, who will be wearing this iconic hat. After letting him speak, antagonize him and stare him down. He will eventually start a fight with you. You may pick his hat up after the brawl.

_Note: This is a different hat than the one available at the Trapper in the Trophy Buck garment set._

title: Letter to Jim from Mildred
description: Appears on the porch some time after encountering the [Wagon Accident](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=34785)

title: Wild Man's Journal

**Requirements:** The Noblest of Man, and a Woman stranger mission.

title: Bad Luck, Bonnie
description:
One of a few potential spawn locations for a 'corpse' that holds the [Lost Letter to Bonnie](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=454465). He'll hand it to you when you try to loot him.

Two chests can be found nearby, too - their loot includes a Silver Pocket Watch & Gin, Guarma Rum, Shotgun Shells, Money & Chewing Tobacco.

title: High Stakes Treasure Hunter
description:
Holds the first High Stakes Treasure Map. You'll need to rob, kill and loot, or purchase it from him for $5.

If you fail to recover the map from him on 3 separate occasions, it will become available for purchase at a Fence.

The treasure hunt continues [here](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=306).

title: Nite Folk Victim
description:
Come here at night, and find a man hung from a tree at the side of the road. After approaching the body, you'll be attacked by three enemies from a faction known as the **Nite Folk.**

After killing them, shoot down the body and loot it to find the [Nite Folk Victim's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892454)

The second time you encounter this event, you will find the [Nite Folk Wagerer's Note](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892455)

title: Ku Klux Klan Meeting
description:
One of many potential locations for a KKK meeting.

They tend to be hostile if you approach. Killing and looting a Klansman wearing dark robes gives you the unique [Meeting Notes](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892449) letter.

title: Crying Woman
description:
Wandering the swamps, you might hear a crying woman. If you approach her, she'll attack and run away. Shoot her from afar for a closer look at her mottled gray skin and white eyes, or chase her to be attacked by a group of Nite Folk.

Rest assured, it gets creepier. If you camp near the area and sleep until midnight, then activate focus, you'll find the tracks of a "Stranger" leading away from where you were sleeping... right to the "crying" woman.

title: Arm Amputation
description:
A man on a horse will call for help, and then fall over. He'll ask you to take him to a doctor in Saint Denis, where you can stick around to watch his arm be sawed off.

A few days later, you can find the man being hanged for killing a woman that made fun of his disfigurement. You can help him again, or leave him to his fate.

title: Ghost of Agnes Dowd
description:
Available during foggy weather between 9pm - 3am

Agnes will appear as a white ghost, or be totally invisible, and can be heard crying. Use your binoculars for a closer look, as she will fade away if you get too close.  

You can encounter this event 16 times, with 2 in-game days between each encounter.  Each time she will have unique dialog.  After the 16th time she won't spawn again.

title: Cave Hermit
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

There are 5 possible stages, each available at least 3 in-game days after the previous one. You'll need to stay in his presence long enough to hear all the man has to say (and to actually see him), even if he asks you to go away.

title: Blind Man Cassidy

Available from Epilogue 1 onward. 

Give this mystical blind man a dollar, and he'll share cryptic visions of the future.

He appears in multiple locations, sharing 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between each encounter.) 

A further 8 visions are available in the Epilogue.

title: Jon
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 12PM & 6AM  

Jon is often seen ranting in Valentine's Smithfields saloon. If you stay close, he will eventually attack you. Knock him out to pick up his [Classic Raccoon Mountain Hat](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892166).

You can also return at a later date to find him in the saloon - without his hat. If you wear his hat in front of him, he'll attack you again.

description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 7PM  

After your initial encounter, you can meet him again if you come back at least 24 in-game hours later.

There are three stages of interaction. The final interaction is only available from Epilogue 1 onward.

description:

title: Anders Helgerson
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 6PM  

Anders is a recruiter for the Chelonian Cult, and will offer you a pamphlet if you talk to him.

A second interaction awaits in the epilogue, and leads to the [Chelonian Master](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=941) encounter.

title: Eugenics Proponent
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 8AM & 6PM  

If you accept a pamphlet from this man, a cutscene ensues. He will run away from you at the next encounter (which is available 1 in-game day after the first), and can be killed with no consequences.

title: Timothy Donahue
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward  

The author of *Get Rich Quick* sells his work for $50. 

If you come back at least 2 in-game days later, you can demand a refund - though you will have to chase him down and loot him for it.

title: Lillian Powell
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward - between 9AM & 9PM  

A drunk, aging writer in the Saint Denis saloon. There are 4 stages to experience, each one 3 in-game days after the last.

title: Sonny

Sonny lives in a cabin here. If you accept his invitation to come inside, you will wake up in the wilderness with some of your money missing and your cores exhausted.

There are 15 interaction stages, with 3 in-game days between them.

The first 10 interactions can be triggered between Chapters 2 - 6, and the last 5 once you begin Epilogue 1.

The [Letter from St. Luke's Academy](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892150) can be looted from the third event.

title: Valentine Hotel Robbery - Room 1B
description:
A stranger here will tell you that his friend double-crossed him, and he wants to get him back.  You'll need to rob the friend's room (1B, bottom floor, opposite the baths) in the nearby Valentine Hotel.  You'll find $50 there, and you'll have the option to split the money with the stranger, or break your word and keep all $50.

**NB:** Some users have mentioned that they cannot find any loot inside the hotel room.  It's unknown if this is a bug or not.

title: Sun Worshipper

Killing the wolves will result in honor loss.

title: Damnable Beast
description:
A stranger is trying to heal the foot of his mount. 

Your arrival will startle him, usually triggering a fatal kick to the head from his horse - though this isn't always guaranteed.

**Tip:** If the stranger's horse bolts, you can chase it down and catch it.

title: O'Driscoll Debt Collection
description:
Two O'Driscolls beating a man near a tree. They demand the man pays them what he owes - what happens next is up to you.

_If you intervene,_ you'll receive Honor after fighting the two O'Driscolls. 

_If you do not intervene,_ the man is knocked out and you will lose Honor.

title: Wolf Attack
description:
A man being mauled by a wolf. 

Kill the wolf, and you'll get the option to share a whiskey or health cure with the man to gain some honor. 

Unfortunately, he'll die from blood loss either way.

title: Kidnapping
description:
A woman can be heard shouting - she's been tied up and thrown onto the back of a horse! 

Kill or hogtie the would-be kidnapper to receive honor.

title: Grand Theft Horse
description:
A Mexican stranger will ask for help after losing his horse. 

If you stop to help, he may attempt to steal *your* horse - and if you hesitate to answer him he might rob you at gunpoint!

title: Prisoner Encounter
description:
A prisoner chained to the rocks may ask you to shoot his chains off.  If you free him, he'll give you the location of this buried [Gold Bar](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=25168)

It's also possible to hogtie and turn him over to any sheriff for a cash reward.

title: Blind Man Cassidy
description:
Available from Chapter 2 onward. 

Give this mystical blind man a dollar, and he'll share cryptic visions of the future.

He appears in multiple locations, sharing 18 different visions in total (with roughly 3 in-game days needing to pass between each encounter.) 

A further 8 visions are available in the Epilogue.

title: Back Alley Mugging
description:
At night, visiting the end of this T-shaped junction at the corner of the church will see a stranger offering to sell weapons.

Follow him, and money will certainly change hands. Return here afterwards to get it back.

Give him the herbs he asks for to receive another bottle of Special Miracle Tonic.

title: Duel With a Drunk
description: When walking into the bar, a drunkard may bump into you and then challenge you to a duel.

title: Big Hank Likes a Spank
description:
At night, if you peer through the window of the house, you'll find a woman spanking a bare-assed man.

You can watch it until you get caught and you lose honor.

title: O'Driscolls
description: O'Driscolls may attack you or otherwise have a presence in this area.

title: The Accident
description:
At night, a prostitute may ask for your help disposing of a body. She killed a man up in her room in the saloon and needs help dealing with it. She will reward you with money, and if you come back in a few days, she'll approach you again with a similar problem. If you help her again you'll lose Honor.


**Tip:** Return to Valentine in the Epilogue and speak to the bartender in the [Saloon](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=168). He'll tell you that the prostitute was actually a serial killer and has been caught; pay a visit to the sheriff's office to find her in one of the jail cells. After this, you can witness her execution by hanging near the [Butcher](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=166).

title: Wagon Accident
description:
A stranger may call you over to the cliff, where a wagon has crashed on the rocks below.

Search the body down below to find the [Bride's Photograph](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892803), and a lockbox on the wagon to find the [Wedding Certificate](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=892804)

title: Cougar Attack
description:
A man is hiding in a tree from a very angry cougar. 

Kill the cougar to save him and gain Honor.

title: Woeful Lover
description:
A young man whines about the apple of his eye, Lily May.

He can be encountered a few times, with a final meeting available in the Epilogue that can play out differently based on your earlier choice to greet or antagonise.

title: Panning for Gold
description:
A man panning for gold by the river. 

He'll say that he hasn't found anything, and asks you to move along. If you remain in the area there is a chance the man will find a gold nugget... which you can steal.

title: Couple Smoking Opium

At night, you can see two men peeking through the window. Join them, and you'll see a man and woman rolling around on the bed and floor while smoking a pipe. 

You can chase the men away to gain honor, but you will lose honor for peeking yourself, and continue to lose more honor if you stay and watch.

description:

description:

This cheat spawns a superior horse in front of you.

title: Ambarino Sign Cheat Code
description:

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 2. Activating Dead Eye level 2 will allow you to manually mark targets with Dead Eye.

title: Red Wagon Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You want everyone to go away" is etched into the wagon.

This cheat removes any bounties you have accrued and ends any lockdowns you have triggered.

title: Vetter's Echo Cheat Code
description:
Take the [Black Widow Spider](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=744) cigarette card and search the desk drawers beneath it to find "You Want Punishment" carved into the top drawer.

This cheat increases your wanted level.

title: Cairn Lake Cheat Code
description:

This cheat spawns a wagon in front of you.

title: Two Crows Cheat Code
description:

This cheat spawns a stagecoach in front of you.

title: Dilapidated House Cheat Code
description:
Go inside the shack to find the code "You want something new".

This cheat spawns a random horse in front of you.

title: Fort Riggs Cheat Code
description:
Inside the building you will find "RUN! RUN! RUN!" written on the chalkboard.

This cheat spawns a race horse in front of you.

title: Lannahechee Shipwreck Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Better than my dog" is etched into the ship.

This cheat increases your whistle range, allowing your horse to find you no matter how far away you are.

title: Millesani Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "A fool on command" can be found inside the mine, hidden in a corner and written in red.

This cheat will instantly make you drunk.

title: Rio Bravo Island Cheat Code
description:
"My kingdom is a horse" is etched into a rock on this island.

This cheat increases your bonding with all horses that you own.

title: Houseboat Cheat Code
description:
Climb over to the end of the little boathouse and find the code "Seek all the bounty of this place"

This cheat increases your Health, Stamina, and Dead Eye bar levels.

title: Cattail Cheat Code
description:
Go inside the railway tunnel to find the cheat code "I seek and I find".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 5. Activating Dead Eye level 5 will highlight critical areas in addition to fatal areas while in Dead Eye.

title: Owanjila Cheat Code
description:
Under the Owanjila Dam is the cheat code "I still seek more".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 4. Activating Dead Eye level 4 will highlight fatal areas while in Dead Eye.

title: Clemens Cove Shipwreck Cheat Code
description:
On the front of the shipwreck you can find the cheat code "I shall be better".

This cheat increases your Dead Eye proficiency to level 3. Activating Dead Eye level 3 will allow you to remain in Dead Eye after firing your weapon.

title: Sunken Boat Cheat Code
description:
In the cabin of the sunken boat is the cheat code "Be greedy only for foresight". 

This cheat allows the use of Infinite Dead Eye.

title: Lookout Tower Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Balance. All is balance" can be found at the top of the tower facing east. It's etched into the top board of the half-wall.

This cheat resets your Honor to absolute neutrality.

title: Barnhouse Cheat Code
description:
On the upper floor of the barnhouse is the cheat code "You revel in your disgrace, I see".

This cheat decreases your Honor level to its lowest possible value.

title: Bacchus Cave Cheat Code
description:
Inside this small cave is the cheat code "Greed is now a virtue".

This cheat gives you $500 every time it is activated.

title: Caretaker House Cheat Code
description:
Open the drawer in the shack to find the cheat code "A simple life, a beautiful death".

This cheat grants access to a loadout of basic weapons.

title: Cornwall K&T Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Keep your dreams light" is carved into the top right drawer of a desk on the bottom floor.

This cheat spawns a buggy in front of you, as seen in the screenshot.

title: Pink Wagon Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "Guide me better" is etched into the wagon.

This cheat increases your deadeye proficiency to level 1. Activating Dead Eye level 1 will set your Dead Eye to automatically mark targets.

title: Lake Don Julio House Cheat Code
description:
Cheat code “Eat of knowledge” is etched into the wall above the door inside the house.

This cheat grants access to all crafting recipes.

title: Fence's Shop Cheat Code
description:
Inside the [Fence's shop](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=19), you can find the cheat code "Vanity. All is Vanity" etched into the top drawer of the first cabinet to your right.

This cheat grants access to all outfits.

title: Pleasance House Cheat Code
description:
Inside [Pleasance House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=30404) there is a chest with the cheat code "Share" etched into it.

This cheat increases the camp's supply levels to their maximum and unlocks all camp upgrades.

title: Trading Post Cheat Code
description:
Go inside the shack and look at the ceiling to find the cheat code "History is written by fools".

This cheat grants access to a loadout of gunslinger weapons.

title: Adler Ranch Cheat Code
description:
On the support beam of the burnt remains of the main house is the code "Death Is Silence"

This cheat grants access to a loadout of stealth weapons.

title: Benedict Pass Cheat Code
description:
The cheat code "You want freedom" is found carved under the bridge.

This cheat decreases your wanted level.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code I (Chapter 1)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette No. 27) during Chapter 1 to find the cheat code "Abundance is the dullest desire".

This cheat code grants the use of unlimited ammo, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code II (Chapter 3)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=33) (Saint Denis Times #46) after the Chapter 3 mission 'Advertising, The Old American Art' to find the cheat code "Greed is American Virtue".

This cheat code grants access to a loadout of heavy weapons, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code III (Chapter 3)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=46) (New Hanover Gazette #31) after the Chapter 3 mission 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' to find the cheat code "You long for sight and see nothing".

This cheat code removes all fog from the world map.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code IV (Chapter 4)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #67) after the Chapter 4 mission 'Urban Pleasures' to find the cheat code "Virtue unearned is not virtue".

This cheat code increases your Honor level to its highest possible value, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code V (Chapter 5)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #68) after returning from Guarma in Chapter 5 to find the cheat code "The lucky be strong evermore".

This cheat code allows the use of infinite stamina, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VI (Chapter 6)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2245) (New Hanover Gazette #36) after the Chapter 6 mission 'The King's Son' to find the cheat code "You seek more than the world offers".

This cheat code refills and fortifies your health, stamina, and Dead Eye, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VII (Epilogue 1)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=128) (Blackwater Ledger #72) after the Epilogue Part 1 mission 'The Wheel' to find the cheat code "You are a beast built for war".

This cheat code spawns a war horse in front of you, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: Newspaper Cheat Code VIII (Epilogue 1)
description:
Purchase a [Newspaper](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=2248) (The Blackwater Ledger #73) after the Epilogue 1 mission 'The Landowning Classes' to find the cheat code "Would you be happier as a clown?"

This cheat code spawns a circus wagon in front of you, but can only be activated if you read the newspaper.

title: UFO
description: Inspect the Mysterious Sermon found inside the shack.  You'll then need to return at 2am and look up through the roof to see the UFO. It will disappear when you step outside.

title: Massive Dead Snake
description: A large snake can be found dead in the branches of a tree here.

title: Witch's Cauldron
description: A cauldron filled with an unknown liquid. Drinking it will result in the a black-out, before waking up several yards away with all cores restored to maximum.

title: Robot
description:
**Requirements:** Complete chapter 4 mission "Joys of Civilization", Complete Marko Dragic stranger missions

If you're using the [Electric Lantern](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=25042), it will glow red/orange as you get closer to the robot

title: Conversation with a Giant - Starting Point
description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals

When you arrive at the location on a **clear day** (not rainy, stormy, snowy or foggy), a flock of birds will take off from the shore.  Follow them until you reach an [inaccessible cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=927#L). A conversation with a kind-hearted giant will automatically start.

You can have a second conversation if you return 3 days later, and two more in the Epilogue.

title: Ghost Train
description: Spawns on this stretch of tracks, generally in the middle of the night or around 3AM.

title: Deformed Singer
description: On the porch, playing a banjo

title: Vampire
description:
**Requirements:** Find the 5 vampire clues: [#1](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=875), [#2](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=876), [#3](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=877), [#4](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=878), [#5](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=879) 

After finding the 5 clues, you'll find a vampire here finishing off his latest victim.  If you kill him, you'll receive an Ornate Dagger

**Note:** You have to come at night, and he may not always spawn. Appears between 00:00 and 01:00.

**Tip:** If you kill him and are unable to find the dagger then it will be available at the Fence.

title: Conversation with a Giant - Cave
description:
**Requirements:** Study at least 30 animals 

After following [this flock of birds](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=730#L), this is the cave where the Giant can be encountered (but not seen).

You can have a second conversation if you return 3 days later, and two more in the Epilogue.

title: Mexico Glitch
description:
**Requirements:** Max horse stamina, stamina + health stimulants & revivers.

**Note:** Save before attempting this glitch.

First, you need to cross the river at the narrowest point, opposite this marker.  Your horse will need stamina + health stimulants to stay alive during this.

Then, head for this marked location.  You need to run your horse into the end of the canyon, and attempt to glitch yourself up to the top ledge (you can use cheats if your horse dies - but make sure you save before doing this).

Eventually you'll be able to glitch yourself up on top of the canyon and explore all of Mexico.

title: Glowing Pentagram
description: A red glowing pentagram appears below a small shack here between 4am and 5am

title: Whiskey Tree
description:
One of the bottles hanging on this tree contains a gold nugget.  Use Eagle Eye to highlight the correct bottle and shoot it to retrieve the gold nugget.

There is also a Ginseng Elixir in the center of the tree

title: Sheep Lover
description: You'll find a [Gold Wedding Ring](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=369) tied to his "wife"

title: Josiah Trelawny's House
description: Head up the stairs here to listen to a conversation inside the Trelawny home. If you wait around for long enough, Arthur will call out to him and have a brief chat.

title: Missing Princess Poster
description: On the outside wall of the saloon. A poster offering a reward for the missing _Princess Isabeau Katharina Zinsmeister_

title: Manzanita Post Mystery
description:
This area is home to a small group of Norwegian immigrants. You can find 3 items for this mystery:

- **Norwegian Journal Page** - inside the chimney of the small cabin.  
- **Norwegian Photo** - found under a loose floorboard.  
- **Norwegian Newspaper Scrap** - looted from the husband.  

By translating these items you can uncover a dark secret about the people here.

title: Alchemist's House
description: When you approach this house for the first time, you'll witness the alchemist's final experiment!

title: The Whispering Forest
description:
Walk through the forest during a fog, and you'll hear 2 voices whispering.

If you go to a theatre and watch "The Ghastly Serenade", you can learn the story of these voices

title: Taxidermy Gorilla
description: Hidden away on the steep slopes of the Big Valley mountains, just northwest of Wallace Station, lies a life-sized gorilla statue that looks as if it fell right out of a circus cargo.

title: Frozen Cattle Drive
description: A herd of cattle frozen in the snow from a failed drive.

title: Well
description: At the bottom of the well in front of the repossessed house, there's 4 quarters and a number of carved tally marks and crosses in the wall - suggesting someone was kept down there against their will.

title: Strange Man Portrait
description: There is a portrait of the Strange Man behind Herbert Moon in the General Store.

title: UFO #2
description: After finding the mysterious sermon and seeing the [first UFO](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=181) at [Hani's Bethel](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=190), come to the peak of Mount Shann and wait until around midnight / 1AM / 2AM for a second glimpse at life beyond the stars.

title: Rock Painting #1
description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

title: Rock Painting #2
description:
On the side of a boulder, facing south

**Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

title: Rock Painting #3
description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

title: Rock Painting #4
description: **Note: Unrelated to the rock carving collectibles.**

title: Leader X Tree
description: A tree with strange markings that can only be spotted from a distance.

title: Shallow Grave
description: You'll find yourself here after a few drinks at [Aberdeen Pig Farm](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=109), and can bring the woman that lives at the pig farm here to get some extra dialogue.

title: Severed Arm
description:
You can catch a severed arm while fishing near the mayor's house.

*Note: Will only appear if you opted to kill Jean-Marc at the end of [Idealism and Pragmatism for Beginners](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=391) III*

title: Pagan Symbols on a Tree (1/3)
description: Carved into a tree north-west of the [Tiny Church](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=356).

title: Pagan Ritual Painting
description: Enter the [Devil's Cave](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=899), cross the bridge and follow the tunnel to the right. The painting is on the left wall just before reaching the room with the ladder.

title: New Hanover Rock Arrangement
description: Just off the path you'll see "New Hanover" spelled out with rocks on the side of the hill.

title: Rains Fall
description:
***Epilogue Only***

Rains Fall can be encountered in the train station here during the epilogue.

title: Meteor Shower
description: At around 2:30 - 3 AM, in the field near the [Meteor House](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=152) - you can see a meteor shower if the sky is clear. The spot is easiest to reach when approaching from the south-west.

title: Joshua Burgess
description:
This gravestone represents an interesting story that is told through a letter found elsewhere on the map, in a wrecked mail truck.

The gravestone reads "Joshua Burgess Accidentally shot August 1898". The shooting occurred less than a year before the beginning of the story. The story in the letter tells of a relationship between the daughter of the man who owns Emerald Ranch and a young man. 

The ranch owner did not approve of the relationship and shot the young man in the saloon which still has blood on the floor and bullet holes in the walls where the shooting occurred.

title: Miriam Wegner
description: Miriam can be seen looking out of the upstairs window around midnight and noon.

title: Workers' Gravestone
description: A single wooden headstone inscribed with the "names" of workers who died while building the railroad. Small piles of clothing can be found nearby.

title: El Presidio
description:
Look across the river to spot this iconic fort that served as a stronghold for the Mexican army in the first Red Dead Redemption.

Cannot be reached without the use of the [Mexico Glitch](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=966)

title: Precarious Wagon
description: A wagon teeters on the edge of a cliff. If you climb inside, you will immediately slip forward and fall to your death. As if that wasn't enough, the game dramatically zooms in as it happens.

title: "Why" Trees
description: Several burned and shattered trees, presumably hit by lightning, can be found here. If you stand at a specific angle, they spell the word "WHY".

title: Pagan Grave
description: A pagan grave with a skull tombstone

title: Pagan Symbols on a Tree 3/3
description: Directly east of the [Tiny Church](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=356), near an Acuna's Star Orchid.

title: Hanging Man & Hearse
description: A hearse was seemingly attacked here, with the coffin it was carrying laying open. The driver, or perhaps the corpse he was transporting, is hanging from the vehicle.

title: Legendary Channel Catfish
description:
**Note:** The Legendary Channel Catfish is not obtainable and was only mentioned when Jeremy Gill tried to catch it during _"A Fisher of Fish II"_.

_After you complete the mission, The Legendary Channel Catfish becomes visible on the map like any other legendary fish, but still cannot be caught._

title: Bayonet in Tree
description: 50 paces from the Southeast corner of the old Bolger Glade Church - a rifle / bayonet is stuck in the tree

title: Ghosts of Bolger Glade
description: Come here during a stormy night to hear ghostly whispers from General Harris & his men during the Battle of Scarlett Meadows of 1864.

title: Pan Tree
description: A bunch of pots and pans are stuck to this tree.

title: Tilly Jackson
description:
***Epilogue Only***

Tilly can be encountered in the park here during the second part of the epilogue.

title: Greta Van Der Linde
description: The final resting place of Dutch's mother can be found here, beside a tree on the middle row.

title: Chain Gang
description: A group of skeletons in prisoner clothing can be found in the woods here. It seems one of them removed his foot to escape the chains, but he couldn't escape the reaper.

title: Cave Painting
description: Inside Elysian Cave

title: Shiver Me Timbers
description: Underneath the bridge, the corpse of a pirate can be found with an unburied chest. You can also find a long-dead dead alligator next to him, and loot the chest for [Bitters & Money](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=841)

title: A Cowboy of No Name
description:
Grave marker for a "Cowboy of No Name" - referencing the "Man With No Name" from _The Good, the Bad and the Ugly_.

The same grave can also be found in the [first game.](https://mapgenie.io/red-dead-redemption/maps/world?locationIds=294302)

title: Simon Pearson
description:
***Epilogue Only***

Pearson can be found inside the [General Store](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=27) during the epilogue.

title: Boat in Tree
description: A boat can be found in a tree here, with chains holding it together.

title: Mary-Beth Gaskill
description: ***Epilogue Only***

title: Lillie <3 Alfred
description:
Carved into a tree just north of Flatneck Station, a few yards past the road.

Lillie adds a few more lines in the epilogue.

title: Thirsty Work
description: The corpses here are holding dowsing rods, implying that they died of dehydration.

title: Caliban's Seat
description: On the northern side of the hill you can find [Valerian Root](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=63932) in an old, unoccupied camp.

title: Two Crows
description: Bears a striking resemblance to a location in Red Dead Revolver

title: Evelyn Miller Camp
description: Note: Unlocked after "The American Inferno, Burnt Out II".

title: Fort Riggs
description:
An abandoned fort that was once used by the US Army as a holding area for captured Native Americans. The story of the fort is told by a drunk army veteran during a random stranger encounter.

A letter can be found in the main building that appears to be practice for the correct spelling of various english words. If you write down the first letter of each word a secret poem is revealed.

title: Siltwater Strand
description: May only appear on the map when you approach it from the other side of the river.

title: Ewing Basin
description: Money clip can be found in a nightstand drawer; several cigars and ammo can be found throughout the shacks

title: The Loft
description: The basement in back is full of ammunition and there are a number of containers inside, including a chest with a gold watch.

title: Carmody Dell
description: A great place to "hunt" cows and bulls - just don't get caught!

title: Micah's Hideout
description: Added to the map during the American Venom mission in Epilogue 2.

title: Gaptooth Breach
description: Home to a [Gang Hideout](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21247).

title: Solomon's Folly
description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=21248)

title: Beecher's Hope
description: Added to the map (and can be used as a [fast travel point](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=1990)) after the "Home on the Gentry" mission in the Epilogue.

title: Hanging Dog Ranch
description: Home to a [Gang Hideout.](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=402)

title: Serial Killer Clue - #2
description:
**Murder Scene:** A dismembered body is tied to a rock. On a nearby rock you'll find a head with "Killer Clue 2 Piece" in its mouth.  

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the [American Dreams](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=320) stranger mission.

title: Serial Killer Clue - #1
description:
**Murder Scene:** A dismembered body is strung up under a bridge. On a stake nearby you'll find a head that has "Killer Clue 1 Piece" in its mouth. You can also shoot the body down.  

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the [American Dreams](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=320) stranger mission.

title: Serial Killer Clue - #3
description:
**Murder Scene:** This body is tied to a large tree. At the base of the tree, you'll find a head on a stake, with "Serial Killer 3 Piece" in its mouth.  

**Mission Unlocked:** Finding all 3 clues unlocks the *American Dreams* stranger mission.

title: Vampire Clue - #1
description: The clue is at ground level, on the wall on the corner of the building. You'll see white writing which you need to examine to begin the investigation.

title: Vampire Clue - #2
description: Just before you enter the market, look to the right of the arch, and you'll see an area with some railings and a metal gate.  The clue is here, on the wall on the left (beside some barrels).

title: Vampire Clue - #3
description: Between the General Store and the Butcher's. The writing is on the wall facing the train tracks to the south.

title: Vampire Clue - #4
description: From the garden with a tree in the middle, go through the archway that's furthest to the right. There, you'll find the writing above a chair, on the corner.

title: Vampire Clue - #5
description: On a wall under the arches.  This clue is slightly difficult to spot, due to the shadows.

title: Panoramic Map POV
description: This is the exact spot depicted in the [Panoramic Map](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=1997). There's also a sundial nearby.

title: Cougar's Den
description: Not a reliable place to find cougars, oddly enough.

title: Micah's Camp
description:
**Availability:** After completing _An American Pastoral Scene_.

Here you will find some old newspaper clippings and documents that Micah has stashed.

title: Burnt-out Wagon
description: A burnt-out wagon, team of oxen, and two bodies.
